identity.fantasy: A battlefield engineer who overlaps bombs, napalm, rockets, turrets, drones, factories, and oil until the whole pull becomes one explosive machine.
identity.one_line: Layer Napalm and oil, deploy after the tank stacks enemies, then turn Sparked and Ready into instant rockets and explosive rounds.

mechanics.core_loop: Bomb Toss, Napalm, rockets, turrets, drones, factories, and oil effects create a busy battlefield. The base concept is simple, but maximizing overlapping explosive windows and deployables is one of the higher-load current DPS jobs.
mechanics.single_target: On durable targets, the structural path grows from Bomb Toss, Napalm, Rocket Launcher toward Rocket Barrage, Explosive Inventor, Hyperblast Barrage. A precise priority remains limited to the captured build and community evidence.
mechanics.aoe: For multiple targets, Layer Napalm and oil, deploy after the tank stacks enemies, then turn Sparked and Ready into instant rockets and explosive rounds. The current evidence particularly constrains this through: Advice says turret placement after gathering is essential; moving packs sharply reduce damage.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Ranged attacks allow space, but factories, oil, turrets, and napalm anchor damage to locations.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Its structural defensive package includes Bomb Toss, Napalm, Build, Build, Duobombers.
mechanics.group_utility: Group or control tools include Build, Surprise Launch!, The BIG Guns!, Bomber Man, Explosive Inventor.
